scope: Static C0 delivery audit of final current fingerprints, historical bytes, complete ZIP/resource/license closures, formal recorded module/workbench observations, original B5 fixture/pixel comparisons, recorded tests, normal production identity, documentation, nested Git and private data. No runtime workload is executed by this audit.

modules.selectionEvidence: Runner issues native Playwright mouse clicks and checks actual hit-state alternation. Raw module selection records do not contain an isTrusted flag.

workbench.console404Attribution: Raw console messages contain no request URL; preserved without claiming zero console errors or attributing them to a specific resource.

comparison.pixelEvidence: Browser-decoded RGBA hashes and dimensions from all 24 exports compared with retained B5 raw evidence; independent static audit checks the eight local PNG files SHA/size/chunks/CRC/dimensions. No new browser or pixel timing run.

documentation.scope: C0 documentation: Markdown links, anchors, tables, JSON examples and identifiers. Static delivery evidence; runtime verification is recorded separately.
